pre_outcome_amendment.reason: The outcome-blind 100%-coverage intersection produced only 28,881 eroded core voxels, violating the predeclared core>=50% common-mask feasibility guard. The repaired core is the one-voxel erosion of the already fixed 95%-coverage common mask (204,421/221,116 voxels); no threshold, endpoint, prediction, SESOI, subject rule, or neural-outcome-dependent choice changed.

selected_tests.primary_estimand: For each contrast, compare the fixed C1/Q0 S0 and S8 equal-cohort inverse-variance group effect maps over the common mask. D_raw = RMS(Y8-Y0)/RMS(Y0). Fit Y0 = alpha + beta*Y8 by ordinary least squares across mask voxels; D_aligned = RMS(Y0-alpha-beta*Y8)/RMS(Y0), aligned_ratio = D_aligned/D_raw, and scale_attenuation = 1-aligned_ratio. Also report spatial Pearson r.
selected_tests.directional_prediction: If amplitude/offset dominates, scale alignment removes at least half the raw smoothing difference (scale_attenuation >= 0.50) and Pearson r >= 0.80 for each contrast in the full equal-cohort result and separately in EI and ER.

sesoi.support_rule: For both contrasts, the full-sample point estimates and 95% paired cohort-stratified bootstrap lower bounds exceed both SESOI thresholds; EI and ER point estimates separately exceed both thresholds.

selected_tests.falsifier: Amplitude/offset dominance is falsified if either contrast fails either full-sample SESOI/interval condition or if either task-version stratum fails either point-estimate threshold.
selected_tests.matched_negative_control: For each S0 group map, create Y_control = 0.1*SD(Y0) + 1.25*Y0. The identical alignment code must give Pearson r within 1e-12 of 1 and aligned residual RMS <= 1e-10*RMS(Y0). Failure is a technical implementation failure, not a scientific result.
selected_tests.strongest_alternative_discriminated: Residual substantive spatial sensitivity rather than removable global amplitude/offset change.

secondary_threshold_control.group_statistic: OLS intercept t statistic with task-version code +0.5 EI and -0.5 ER; separate one-sample t statistics within EI and ER
secondary_threshold_control.procedure: two-sided Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.05 separately for each smoothing, contrast, and group/stratum
readouts: matched-cardinality top-absolute-t Jaccard with k=min(S0 rejected count,S8 rejected count)
secondary_threshold_control.disconnect_rule: Threshold-crossing disconnect is flagged when FDR Jaccard <0.25 but matched-cardinality top-|t| Jaccard >=0.50; broad spatial relocation is flagged when both are <0.25. If k=0 the matched-cardinality readout is undefined and no disconnect claim is allowed.
secondary_threshold_control.role: secondary fixed control; never tuned and never treated as an additional test

selected_tests.primary_estimand: Using the same C1/Q0 S0/S8 run estimates, compare inverse-variance (IVW), equal-run, and stabilized-IVW subject aggregation. For each group map define Delta=Y8-Y0, edge_enrichment=mean(Delta^2 in periphery)/mean(Delta^2 in core), core_ratio=D_raw_core/D_raw_full, and aggregation_attenuation=1-D_raw_alternative_full/D_raw_IVW_full.
selected_tests.directional_prediction: An edge/weighting mechanism predicts, for each contrast, IVW edge_enrichment >=2.0, core_ratio <=0.75, and at least 25% attenuation under equal-run or stabilized-IVW aggregation. EI and ER must each show edge_enrichment >=1.5 and core_ratio <=0.85.

sesoi.support_rule: For both contrasts, full-sample point estimates and paired-bootstrap 95% lower/upper bounds satisfy edge_enrichment/core_ratio respectively; at least one alternative aggregation meets attenuation by point estimate and lower bound; EI and ER point estimates meet their stratum thresholds.

selected_tests.falsifier: The mechanism is falsified if either contrast fails any full-sample support component, neither alternative aggregation attenuates by 25%, or either task-version stratum fails its edge/core point thresholds.
matched_negative_controls: Equal-run subject aggregation gives all four runs identical weight and removes inverse-variance leverage while preserving effects, subjects, masks, and smoothing.
Stabilized IVW floors each positive finite run-variance map at its predeclared within-map 0.1st percentile before inversion, preserving the upper 99.9% of its spatial variance ranking.
selected_tests.strongest_alternative_discriminated: Spatial sensitivity persisting in well-covered core voxels and under aggregation that cannot be dominated by extremely small variances.

shared_first_level_model.reason: One fixed intermediate confound model isolates smoothing and avoids rerunning the v1 confound multiverse.
shared_first_level_model.task_and_drift_terms: Unchanged FitLins run design task regressors gain_demean, loss_demean, trial_type.decision, trial_type.missed, rt_reg.rt, native cosine columns, and intercept.
shared_first_level_model.motion_terms: Six native motion parameters, their first differences with first row zero, squared originals, and squared derivatives; nuisance columns stay in native units.
shared_first_level_model.smoothing_application: isotropic Gaussian smoothing on 4D fMRIPrep BOLD before GLM
shared_first_level_model.contrast_vectors: Unit weight on the unchanged gain_demean or loss_demean design column, zero elsewhere.
shared_first_level_model.subject_handling: All 108 technically eligible subjects (Q0); no QC exclusion or censoring. Gain and loss are never pooled or compared in magnitude.
shared_first_level_model.nonfinite_policy: Any nonfinite required design value, contrast nonestimability, nonfinite effect, or nonpositive/nonfinite variance prevents that subject checkpoint and is a technical failure if not repairable without changing this contract.

masks.common_mask: Include voxels covered by at least 95% of all 432 run masks and at least 95% of the 216 masks in each task-version cohort; use one mask for both contrasts, smoothings, and aggregations.
masks.core_mask: Apply one iteration of 3D binary erosion with six-neighbor connectivity to the fixed 95%-coverage common mask.
masks.validity: Common mask must be nonempty and at least 50% of the median run-mask size; core must contain at least 50% of common-mask voxels; periphery must contain at least 1% of common-mask voxels. Otherwise technical_failure.

group_estimands.primary: For each subject map, compute the EI mean and ER mean, then average those two cohort maps with weight 0.5 each.
group_estimands.task_version_controls: Repeat map comparisons within EI and ER separately. These are internal robustness/task-version association controls, not independent confirmation.
group_estimands.sample_composition_rule: A mechanism cannot be candidate_ready if its required direction is absent in either EI or ER.
group_estimands.amplitude_alignment: Fit alpha and beta across voxels separately for each contrast, group/stratum, mask region, and aggregation; do not transfer parameters between results.
group_estimands.variance_stabilization: For each subject, run, smoothing, and contrast separately, floor positive finite run variances at their common-mask 0.1st percentile before inverse weighting.

bootstrap.method: paired cohort-stratified ordinary subject bootstrap with replacement
bootstrap.reuse: Reuse each replicate's sampled subject indices across both smoothings, both contrasts, all masks, and all aggregation strategies.
bootstrap.implementation: Exact region-specific subject-map sums and Gram matrices may replace explicit voxel maps without changing any estimand.

uncertainty_and_robustness.deterministic_split_half: Within each task version, sort subject IDs and alternate them into A/B halves; combine corresponding EI/ER halves. Report all primary metrics in both halves. Candidate direction must be the same in both halves, but SESOI crossing is not required in halves.
uncertainty_and_robustness.small_subject_guard: Report leave-one-subject-out influence on D_raw and edge_enrichment. A candidate is disallowed if removing any one subject changes the relevant full-sample point estimate across its SESOI threshold.
uncertainty_and_robustness.interpretation: All robustness is internal to ds001734.

candidate_decision_hierarchy.rule: T2 support rule passes for both contrasts, split-half directions agree, and the small-subject guard passes.
T1 support rule passes for both contrasts, T2 does not pass, split-half directions agree, and the small-subject guard passes.

T1 amplitude support and T2 edge/weighting support both fail; under equal-run aggregation in the core, both contrasts have D_raw >=0.25 and Pearson r <=0.80 in the full result and in EI and ER, with both split halves in the same direction and the small-subject guard passing.

For both contrasts in the full result and EI/ER strata, Pearson r >=0.80, FDR Jaccard <0.25, and matched-cardinality top-|t| Jaccard >=0.50; split-half directions and the small-subject guard must pass.

terminal_rules.candidate_ready: Exactly the highest-priority candidate whose complete frozen rule passes; report only one candidate.
terminal_rules.closed_no_candidate: All analyses and controls complete but no candidate hierarchy rule passes, or a result is inconclusive/unstable under its frozen robustness checks.
terminal_rules.technical_failure: Required source, mask, estimability, runtime, storage, or checkpoint completeness prevents the frozen tests from completing after allowed engineering repair.
terminal_rules.post_hoc_results: Any metric not explicitly declared above is descriptive post-hoc and cannot affect terminal status.

resource_and_stop_conditions.stop_after: The two selected tests, controls, robustness checks, required artifacts, and terminal bundle are complete; do not widen the search.
